name: Phishing Link / Malicious Website Fraud
ncrpCategory: Online Financial Fraud -> Phishing / Fake Link / Malicious Website
summary: Deceptive SMS, emails, or WhatsApp messages claiming urgent electricity bill payment, courier address updates, or lottery prizes, leading to spoofed websites that steal funds and credentials.
rules: Never click on shortened links or unverified URLs received via SMS or WhatsApp.
Official utility departments (electricity, water, gas) never send disconnection threats containing personal mobile numbers for payment.
initialActionChecklist: If money was debited, immediately call 1930 with transaction UTR numbers to request beneficiary freeze.
If bank credentials or card details were entered on the phishing page, immediately change your passwords and block cards via your bank app.
Take screenshots of the phishing SMS/message displaying the sender header, timestamp, and full URL.
Report the malicious URL and sender number on cybercrime.gov.in and Chakshu.
Run an antivirus or malware scan on your device if any APK or attachment was downloaded.
evidenceRequired: Screenshot of the SMS / WhatsApp message with sender ID and complete link text
Screenshot of the phishing web page if captured
Transaction receipts or bank debit SMS if financial transfer occurred
Browser history showing the exact visited phishing domain
source: CERT-In Phishing Incident Advisory & MHA I4C
